title: Composer and MCP parsers disagree on Unicode whitespace around the slash-command -- separator
outcome:
Found by the Claude /review-code of tm-p619 (delegation-d65b3097, 2026-09-25). The difference predates tm-p619; the old UI regex also used /\s/u.

The UI's splitAgentCommandResolverTail (ui/src/panels/session-agent-command-submission.ts, around line 55) accepts any Unicode whitespace (/\s/u: U+2003, U+00A0, U+3000, \v) around `--`. The MCP bridge's split_mcp_agent_command_tail (src/delegation_mcp.rs, around line 2887) accepts only ASCII whitespace, and a Rust test pins `staged\u{2003}--\u{2003}include tests` as not splitting. So the same `/review-code ... -- ...` text can resolve differently from the composer than from termal_spawn_session. Native commands reject notes, so one path can fail with 400 while the other works.

tm-p619's new UI comment ("Match the MCP parser: ...") is about the backtick rule, which does match, but it reads as full parity.

Fix: use an ASCII whitespace class ([\t\n\f\r ]) in the UI check, or else document the difference and narrow the comment. Add em-space and NBSP cases to both the Rust and the Vitest tables. See also the shared-fixture follow-up.
